{{Quote|By order of His Majesty Emperor Palpatine and the Imperial Space Ministry, to all whom it may concern, you are commanded to permit the galactic citizen named herein to pass without delay or hindrance and in case of need to give all lawful aid and protection. Failure to comply with this order, or the alteration, falsification, or unlawful use of this passport, will result in persecution under existing Imperial statutes, up to and including summary execution.|Official statement on the Passport|<ref name="Galactic Passport (real-life artifact)">[[Galactic Passport (real-life artifact)|''Galactic Passport'']]</ref>}}
'''Galactic Passports''' were passports issued to citizens of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] issued exclusively by the [[Imperial Space Ministry/Legends|Imperial Space Ministry]], by order of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. These passports allowed the bearer unrestricted passage throughout the Empire. The Galactic Passports included information about the bearer's identity, including birth date, place of birth, [[Species/Legends|species]], and [[Gender/Legends|gender]]. The passport was written in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], using both [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] and the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]].

It is also a major crime to prevent the bearer unrestricted passage across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], with the punishment being persecution under existing Imperial statutes, which went up to and even included summary execution. The same sentencing applied to those who attempted to use the passport in an unlawful manner or if the passport itself was falsified or altered.
